decks.notes: This deck aims to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures that can be returned to the battlefield with Living End, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and disruptive creatures like Grief. The deck also includes cards like Violent Outburst to cascade into Living End for a powerful combo finish. The lands are focused on providing the right colors of mana and a mix of utility lands to support the main strategy. It's all about setting up a big board state and overwhelming the opponent with powerful creatures.

This deck revolves around using Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, in combination with various artifacts and Teferi, Time Raveler to generate a winning combo. The goal is to assemble the pieces for a powerful synergistic engine that can quickly overwhelm the opponent and win the game through a combination of card advantage, deck manipulation, and direct damage. By leveraging the power of Breach alongside key cards like Grinding Station and Mishra's Bauble, the deck aims to establish board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition.

This deck focuses on using aggressive red creatures and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. The key concept is to apply pressure early in the game and prevent the opponent from stabilizing by utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Bonecrusher Giant. The inclusion of Obosh, the Preypiercer as a companion enhances the damage output of odd mana cost cards. Additionally, cards like Blood Moon and Relic of Progenitus disrupt the opponent's mana base and graveyard strategies. Overall, the deck aims to win through a combination of fast creatures and direct damage spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly deploy aggressive creatures such as Dragon's Rage Channeler, Murktide Regent, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while controlling the board with counterspells and removal like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also utilizes cantrips like Consider and Expressive Iteration to draw cards and find the right answers. The inclusion of Mishra's Bauble helps with card selection and fueling Delirium for Dragon's Rage Channeler. The deck also has a disruptive element with Blood Moon to punish greedy mana bases. Overall, the deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly and efficiently to bring out big threats, primarily Primeval Titan, to overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy involves utilizing land tutors like Amulet of Vigor and Urza's Saga to get the necessary lands, while also utilizing the bounce lands and lands with multiple abilities to maximize mana production. The deck aims to establish a dominant board presence with powerful creatures and land synergies to control the game and achieve victory.

This deck focuses on aggressively casting spells that have Cascade effects, allowing you to cheat out powerful creatures like Crashing Footfalls and generate extra value from cards like Shardless Agent. By cascading into these spells, you can overwhelm your opponent with a fast and efficient board presence while disrupting their game plan with cards like Brazen Borrower and Force of Negation. The inclusion of versatile cards like Prismari Command and Blood Moon help to control the board and disrupt your opponent's strategy, while lands like Otawara, Soaring City and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional utility and protection.

This deck focuses on controlling the board and manipulating the game through the use of elementals. By utilizing powerful creatures like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef, alongside control spells like Solitude and Teferi, Time Raveler, the deck aims to dominate the battlefield and outmaneuver opponents. With support from cards like Wrenn and Six for card advantage and Prismatic Ending for removal, the elemental creatures are able to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory. Additionally, the inclusion of Kaheera, the Orphanguard as a companion provides additional synergy and boosts the deck's overall strategy.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck in Modern 1 vs 1 is to maintain pressure on the opponent through efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells such as Spell Pierce and Counterspell. Mishra's Bauble and Consider provide card advantage and deck filtering, allowing for consistent plays. Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide additional removal and reach to finish off the opponent. The mana base consists of a mix of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent access to all colors needed for the spells in the deck.

The focus of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana and search for key land pieces using cards like Primeval Titan and Urza's Saga. By utilizing Amulet of Vigor and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove, the deck aims to generate excess mana and play lands with multiple abilities in a single turn. The deck also includes utility lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Boseiju, Who Endures to provide additional advantages. By efficiently combining these elements, the deck can create explosive turns and go off with its powerful combo potential.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponents with cascade spells. By casting cards such as Fury, Shardless Agent, and Violent Outburst, the player can generate advantage while putting pressure on the opponent. Crashing Footfalls provides a consistent stream of token creatures, while Leyline Binding and Dead/Gone offer removal options. The land base includes a mix of fetch lands and triomes to ensure consistent mana access. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, efficient threats and disruption.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty early in the game. The deck also includes Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to help find combo pieces and Leyline Binding to help control the board. By combining creativity and control elements, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its own win condition through powerful creature plays. The use of versatile spells like Prismari Command and Teferi, Time Raveler adds flexibility to adapt to different situations and keep the opponent off balance.

The main focus of the deck is to use Death's Shadow in combination with other aggressive creatures and removal spells to control the board and deal significant damage to the opponent quickly. By using cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Lightning Bolt, and Thoughtseize, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building up a formidable board presence. The inclusion of Underworld Breach allows for graveyard recursion and additional card advantage, while the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana ramp and utility to further enhance the deck's aggressive strategy.

This deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful artifact-based combo using Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin. By equipping the hammer for free with Puresteel Paladin's ability, the deck can create explosive turns where it deals massive amounts of damage in a single attack. The deck also includes other equipment cards like Sword of Fire and Ice and Nettlecyst for additional power and utility. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a lethal combination of equipment, creatures, and combat tricks before they have a chance to respond.

The deck focuses on assembling a game-winning combo using equipment cards like Colossus Hammer and Kaldra Compleat to create a powerful threat that can quickly take down opponents. It utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to tutor for and equip these powerful artifacts efficiently. With cards like Urza's Saga and Sigarda's Aid providing additional support, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with its powerful equipment combo. The inclusion of cards like Spell Pierce and Giver of Runes also helps protect the combo from disruption, ensuring a swift victory.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly build up a board of powerful Merfolk creatures, supported by cards that enhance their abilities and provide disruption for the opponent. By utilizing synergy between Merfolk creatures and cards like Master of the Pearl Trident and Lord of Atlantis, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays and tempo swings. The inclusion of disruption spells like Force of Negation and Dismember allows the deck to control the game and protect its creatures. Additionally, lands like Mutavault and Cavern of Souls ensure consistency and mana efficiency.

The deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent along with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Lightning Bolt to control the board and pressure the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help fuel graveyard synergies and maintain card advantage. The deck is designed to maintain a fast pace and disrupt the opponent's game plan while aggressively attacking with evasive threats. The mana base ensures consistency and flexibility for casting spells effectively. Overall, the key idea is to be able to control the game while applying fast and consistent pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to use aggressive elemental creatures to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck focuses on generating strong synergy between elemental creatures and other cards in order to maintain board presence and deal damage efficiently. It includes powerful elemental creatures such as Omnath, Locus of Creation and Risen Reef to generate value and gain advantages. Additionally, the deck includes control elements such as Lightning Bolt and Teferi, Time Raveler to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain tempo. Overall, the deck aims to win through aggressive creature-based strategies while maintaining control in the game.

This deck focuses on using cards with Cascade to quickly cast spells for free, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays. By utilizing Cascade mechanics and a mix of instant-speed disruption and creatures, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while maintaining control over the game. The mana base is designed to support the multicolored spells and Cascade effects, ensuring consistency in casting powerful spells each turn. With a mix of tempo plays and explosive threats, the deck looks to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on creating explosive turns by casting cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cheat out powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls. It aims to overwhelm opponents quickly with a combination of aggressive creatures like Brazen Borrower and efficient removal spells like Subtlety. The deck also utilizes disruptive elements like Blood Moon and Force of Negation to control the game and disrupt opponent's strategies. The land base includes fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent mana base and access to all necessary colors.

The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Fury provide additional versatility and removal options, making it difficult for opponents to keep up with the relentless aggression of the deck. The main concept of the deck is to use Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty by sacrificing tokens created by cards like Dwarven Mine. Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler are used to protect the combo, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides additional value and consistency. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Prismari Command to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. This deck focuses on assembling the combo of Colossus Hammer and a creature equipped with it, such as Gingerbrute or Kaldra Compleat, to deal massive damage quickly. It utilizes cards like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Sigarda's Aid to tutor for and equip the hammer efficiently. With support from cards like Esper Sentinel and Spell Pierce for disruption, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, powerful attacks. The inclusion of Urza's Saga provides additional utility and flexibility in fetching key pieces for the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing +1/+1 counters in combination with artifacts to create a powerful aggro strategy. Hardened Scales is a key card that boosts the effectiveness of counters placed on creatures, while cards like Arcbound Ravager and Zabaz, the Glimmerwasp benefit from and distribute counters to create explosive board states. The deck also includes synergistic artifacts like Urza's Saga and The Ozolith to further enhance the strategy. By combining aggressive creatures with artifact synergy, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently.

The main concept of this deck is to cheat out powerful creatures from the graveyard by cycling through your deck quickly and casting Living End to bring them back all at once, overwhelming your opponent with a sudden surge of creatures. The deck utilizes cards like Street Wraith and Architects of Will to cycle through the deck, while also having Colossal Skyturtle and Grief to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes counter spells like Force of Negation to protect the combo. This strategy aims to win the game quickly and decisively.

Utilize The Underworld Cookbook and Goryo's Vengeance to cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Atraxa, Grand Unifier quickly. The strategy revolves around combining graveyard interaction with powerful reanimation effects to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly. Additionally, the deck includes powerful artifacts like Brainstone and Blood Fountain to further support its game plan.

The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an additional layer of consistency to the deck. Additional support comes from cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to help filter through the deck and find key pieces.
